message: バイオハザード

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hmm-hmm-hmm~♪ Hmm-hmm-hmm-hmm~♪」

name: Synn
message: 「You seem to be in a good mood.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ehehe. You can tell?」

name: Synn
message: 「Did something really happy happen on this morning's 'Kirara' or something?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, you see, something amazing happened.」

name: Synn
message: 「What, what? My heart's pounding.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Did I already tell you up to the part where the Nishikata family got split up?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. The dad's on a tuna fishing boat. The mom went to Tokyo to work, and the older brother is missing.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So, Kirara came to Tokyo with her mom, right, but then her mom got totally hooked on a new religion.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa. Even that mom who's always positive-thinking and never gives up ended up like that!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Despairing over her mom handing over all her income to the cult, Kirara ran out of the house and her feet naturally carried her to that music college.」

name: Synn
message: 「A-And then?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Seeing the students filling the music college campus felt like her own lost future, making her so heartbroken that Kirara kept walking further and further away from people.」

name: Synn
message: 「Uh-huh.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And then, she wandered into a storage room. And lined up among all the instruments was that oboe.」

name: Synn
message: 「No way!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Overwhelmed by the unexpected reunion, Kirara plays the oboe while crying. And its melody echoes all across the campus.」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't tell me, her missing older brother was drawn in by that sound.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Bullseye! What's more, the professors were so impressed by her playing that they decided to let her take a special entrance exam.」

name: Synn
message: 「No kidding! How happy is that! No wonder you're in such a good mood, Nanaka.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, that's one thing, and this is another, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ta-da!! I've decided on our attraction, J!」

name: Synn
message: 「A maid cafe?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, a maid cafe.」

name: Eddie
message: 「Whoa, a maid cafe!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Certain folks are gonna get real hyped over that.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「It's something Synn-kun totally loves~」

name: Synn
message: 「Even if you say that, I've only ever heard about them...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Then you should use this chance to learn all about them~」

name: Eddie
message: 「Yeah, but what are we gonna do about the uniforms?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Already got that covered with my connections!」

name: Synn
message: 「What about the actual sweets? Nobody here can make any, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Having the Delicious Food Squad help out... guess that's out of the question.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「We'll pull it off using employer privileges~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Those guys are a bit hopeless at cooking... all they ever do is grill stuff.」

name: Synn
message: 「How wild.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, I know. Lemon water!」

name: Synn
message: 「Lemon water?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We'll be fine if we just put lemon in mineral water and serve that! A cake shop called Chick House did that before!」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-That's an amazing cake shop, only serving that.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「As if that would ever be the case!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, serving does tie into dressing up in costumes, so I think it's fine, though...」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, if that's all we do, I don't think it'll count as the Sweets Club actually doing anything?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gahhh, so the issue really is the sweets, huh!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Think that stuff through from the start.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Guess we'll have no choice but to buy sweets from the convenience store and serve those!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「That's expensive~」

name: Synn
message: 「You know, even if it's something simple, let's just try making it ourselves.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Well, that's... um...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「No way, that's a bad idea~! You'll make the customers pass out in agony~」

name: Synn
message: 「What are you planning to make?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gaaah! That's why I said I'm not making anything!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Though, Nana-chan, making Synn-kun pass out in agony might actually be a good idea~. Under the pretext of nursing him back to--mmphhhhhhh.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm not making anything!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Not the pickled plum~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Anyway, it's decided--we're doing a maid cafe! We'll figure out the sweets later!」

name: Synn
message: 「So pushy...」
